newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN says fraud case smaller than reported.
newsitem.headline: ABN says fraud case smaller than reported.

text.p: ABN AMRO NV on Tuesday denied a newspaper report that it had lost some 140 million guilders in a fraud case.
But spokesman Jules Prast said the bank was investigating a fraud case of two uncovered cheques involving 1.07 million guilders and that it expected to reclaim the money.
Dutch daily De Telegraaf reported ABN AMRO had been a victim of a Canadian swindler, resulting in a loss of some 100 million Canadian dollars (or some 140 million guilders).
Prast told Reuters: "The story is complete nonsense."
"We still expect to get this money back and we do not expect to have any financial damage from this," he added.
Last week ABN AMRO denied a seperate report in De Telegraaf of a 185 million guilders fraud on the bank.
At 0900 GMT ABN AMRO shares were up 0.40 guilders at 126.90.
